What is AdSpy?

AdSpy is an advertising espionage tool focused on Facebook and Instagram, recognized for the depth of its database: over 204 million ads, 88 languages and 225 countries. Its strength is search: you can filter by ad text, advertiser name, user comments, affiliate network, Offer ID or landing page technology. Media buyers and affiliates use it to spot the angles that convert before spending a single cent on testing.

The problem is that everything stops there. AdSpy covers only Facebook and Instagram (no native TikTok), charges a single rate of $149/month with no entry plan, and includes neither a winning products database, nor store analysis, nor store creation. For a dropshipper who wants to go from product research all the way to going live, it's one piece of the puzzle, not the complete workflow. Which is exactly why it's worth looking elsewhere.

How do I choose the right alternative to AdSpy?

1. Define your main need

Are you looking for a complete solution?
→ Copyfy covers product research, ad analysis AND store creation.

Are you on a tight budget and want multi-network?
→ BigSpy starts at $19/month.

Do you want to spy on social ads (Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest) and uncover winning products?
→ Minea is built for that, and it's very French-friendly. For native or push affiliation, go for Anstrex instead.

Do you want to cover 10 networks at once?
→ PowerAdSpy is the broadest.

2. Essential choice criteria

Feature/price ratio
Ask yourself: ""Am I only paying for ad espionage, or for a complete workflow?"" AdSpy at $149/month only does analysis.

Platform coverage
AdSpy limits itself to Facebook and Instagram. If TikTok matters in your strategy, check that the tool really covers it.

Support and language
For the French-speaking market, support in French changes the game. Copyfy is the only one of the bunch to offer it.

Creation vs analysis
Ask yourself whether you just want to observe the competition or also launch your store. Only Copyfy does both.

3. The free test is your best ally

Most of these platforms offer a trial (sometimes at $1). Test at least 2-3 tools before you commit:

  1. Copyfy (5 days): to test the complete workflow

FAQ - Alternatives to AdSpy

What is the best free alternative to AdSpy?

There is no 100% free equivalent to AdSpy. However, you can rely on:

  • Facebook Ad Library (free but manual)
  • TikTok Creative Center (free but limited)
  • Anstrex Dropship (free module) or the free trial of Copyfy (5 days) to test without risk

Why look for an alternative to AdSpy?

AdSpy remains excellent on Facebook and Instagram, but it has three limits that push people to look elsewhere: a single rate of $149/month with no beginner plan, coverage restricted to Meta (no native TikTok), and the total absence of product or store features. Many dropshippers want to pay less and get more than a simple ad spy.

How do I migrate my data from AdSpy?

Migrating is easy:

  1. Export or note your favorite ads and advertisers from AdSpy
  2. Create your account on the new platform
  3. Recreate your watch lists or your saved searches

With Copyfy, you can directly analyze the stores behind the ads you followed on AdSpy and copy them in 1 click.

Is Copyfy really better than AdSpy?

The two tools don't play in the same category:

Choose AdSpy if : you are a media buyer or affiliate who wants ONLY the most advanced Facebook ad search (comments, Offer ID, demographics).

Choose Copyfy if : you want a complete dropshipping workflow (analysis + products + store creation + automation), with coaching and support in French.

For 90% of dropshippers, Copyfy offers a better ROI because it covers the whole journey, not just espionage.

Can I use multiple tools at the same time?

Yes, some pro dropshippers combine:

  • Copyfy for the complete workflow (products + store)
  • BigSpy for multi-network creative volume
  • Facebook Ad Library to check manually

But for most users, a single complete tool like Copyfy is more than enough.

What tool to start dropshipping?

For a total beginner, Copyfy is the most logical choice:

  • Free e-commerce training included
  • AI store builder (no technical skills required)
  • Weekly coaching to unlock situations
  • Responsive French-speaking support
  • Accessible price: €39/month to start

What alternative to AdSpy should you choose?

AdSpy remains an excellent Facebook advertising espionage tool, but it is no longer the only viable option. According to your profile and your goals:

🏆 For most dropshippers : Copyfy offers the best feature/price ratio with a complete workflow from A to Z.

💰 For tight budgets : BigSpy lets you monitor several networks from $19/month.

🚀 For multi-network social ad spying and winning products : Minea covers Facebook, TikTok and Pinterest with influencer data, while Anstrex stays the native and push reference.

📱 For covering the most networks : PowerAdSpy sweeps 10 platforms.

🎯 For pure Facebook Ads experts : AdSpy remains the reference (but at a premium price).

Our recommendation: Start by testing Copyfy free for 5 days. You will have access to all the features (Ad Spy, Product Database, Store AI) and will be able to generate your first store in a few minutes.

FAQ - Alternatives to Adsparo

What is the best free alternative to Adsparo?

There is no 100% free alternative equivalent to Adsparo. However, you can use:

  • Facebook Ad Library (free but 100% manual, no backup)
  • TikTok Creative Center (free but limited data)
  • BigSpy (free plan limited to 5 searches/day)

For professional use, free trials of Copyfy (5 days), Foreplay (7 days) or Minea (7 days) allow you to test without risk before making a commitment.

Why is Adsparo not enough for professional use?

Adsparo has several limitations for professional use:

  1. Instability : Dependency on a Chrome extension vulnerable to Meta updates
  2. Facebook only : No TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn coverage
  3. No collaboration : Impossible to share with a team
  4. No analysis : No real performance or sales data
  5. No AI : Lack of automatic analysis of hooks or generation of briefs

Professional alternatives fill these gaps with stable, multi-platform, and AI-powered cloud platforms.

Can I use multiple tools at the same time?

Yes, some professionals combine several tools according to their needs:

Dropshipping combination:

  • Copyfy (full product → store workflow)
  • Facebook Ad Library (free manual check)

Creative agency combination:

  • Foreplay (collaborative swipe files)
  • Minea (detailed advertising espionage)

But for 90% of users, a single complete tool (Copyfy for dropshipping, Foreplay for creatives) is more than enough and avoids dispersion.

How do I migrate my saved ads from Adsparo?

The migration depends on the tool chosen:

To Copyfy:

  1. Identify the stores/products you were following in Adsparo
  2. Use the “Shop Analysis” function to analyze these stores directly
  3. Use “Ad Spy” with the same keywords to find relevant ads
  4. Save as favorites in Copyfy

To Foreplay:

  1. Export your ad URLs from Adsparo (if possible)
  2. Import them directly into Foreplay via the “Add by URL” function
  3. Organize by collections

Most modern tools allow import by URL, making the transition easier.

What is Countik?

Countik is a 100% free TikTok analysis tool launched in 2020, allowing the performance of any public TikTok profile to be monitored in real time. The tool excels in live follower counting and basic analysis of recent videos.

Countik highlights:

  • Real-time counter (updated every 10 seconds)
  • Profile analysis (engagement rate, revenue estimate)
  • Additional tools (hashtag generator, video downloader)
  • Fast and easy interface

Countik limits:

  • No TikTok ad espionage
  • No TikTok Shop data or sales
  • App removed from the Google Play Store
  • Intrusive ads

What is Dropship.io?

Dropship.io is a product research and competitive analysis platform created for Shopify e-retailers. Launched in the early 2020s, the platform stands out for its approach that focuses on Shopify sales data rather than pure advertising espionage.

Dropship.io highlights:

  • Product Library with millions of indexed products and their estimated revenue
  • Ad Library to analyze Facebook ads (expenses, reach, ad sets)
  • Portfolio: every week, up to 40 products selected by the team
  • Competitor Research to identify stores that sell the same product
  • Magic AI Search to find products and ads by image or keyword
  • Chrome extension to track sales in real time

Dropship.io limits:

  • Pricing in dollars: from $39/month (Basic) to $99/month (Premium), which weighs on the exchange rate
  • Accuracy of sales data contested by some users
  • No built-in store builder
  • Recent TikTok coverage, less mature than specialized tools
  • Credit system that limits searches (10,000 credits/month on the Basic plan)
  • Support mainly by email and chat, no personalized coaching

Dropship.io is still a good choice if your priority is tracking Shopify stores and analyzing Facebook Ads. But if you're looking for a tool that goes beyond research, the alternatives below offer different approaches.

1. Copyfy: product research + store creation in one tool 🏆

Copyfy doesn't just analyze products and ads. It is the only platform that covers the complete journey: you find your product, you analyze the competition, and you generate your Shopify store directly from the tool. A considerable time saver compared to Dropship.io where you have to juggle several services to go from research to launch.

Why Copyfy over Dropship.io?

A complete journey, not just data. Where Dropship.io stops at research and tracking, Copyfy adds Store AI, a store builder that creates copywriting, structure, and visuals from a simple product link (AliExpress, Amazon, or Shopify). In 5 minutes, your store is ready to import to Shopify. Dropship.io offers one-click product import, but the construction of the store is entirely up to you.

Comparable advertising data, plus a store module. Copyfy's Ad Spy covers Meta and TikTok ads with filters by date, duration, and spend. The Top Stores module analyzes thousands of Shopify stores with their traffic, acquisition sources, and best sellers. Dropship.io offers similar functionality through Competitor Research, but without traffic source analysis.

More legible pricing. Copyfy invoices in euros: 49€/month (Starter), 89€/month (Growth) or 129€/month (Pro). The Growth plan includes unlimited research, the creation of unlimited AI stores, and weekly coaching with an e-commerce expert. At Dropship.io, the Standard plan at $59/month still has credit limits (25,000/month).

Ad Spy: Analysis of Meta and TikTok ads with “Recent” filters to identify rising trends. Ad activity status, export and download creative items in one click.

Product database: over 100,000 products with verified sales figures “Trending New Shop” and “Strong Growth” pre-filters to detect growing products before they explode.

Store AI (exclusive to Copyfy): Paste a product link, the AI generates a complete store with sales texts, visuals and optimized conversion structure. Import to Shopify in one click. Estimated gain: 40 hours per store.

Shop Analysis: estimated sales, Shopify themes and apps used, best sellers with calculated margins, and the ability to copy the store with AI.

For whom?

✅ You want to go from research to launch without changing tools

✅ You are just starting out and you have no technical skills in web design

✅ Do you want coaching and training included in the subscription

✅ You are targeting French-speaking markets

  • Pro: 89€/month (followed by 120 shops, verified agents)
  • Free 5-day trial without a credit card
  • 40% discount on annual plans

Define your main need

Do you want a tool that does everything from research to launch?→ Copyfy is the only one that covers product research, competitive analysis AND AI store creation.

Do you want the broadest advertising base on the market?→ Minea with its 500M+ ads and its Pinterest cover.

Do you want to validate products using actual advertising expenses?→ Winning Hunter gives you access to ad spend data on Facebook and TikTok.

Starting out on a limited budget?→ Ecomhunt offers a free plan and turnkey product sheets.

Are you looking for automated scraping with fresh data?→ NicheScraper analyzes the trends of the last 7 days on AliExpress.

The criteria that really matter

Feature/price ratio. Ask yourself the question: are you only paying for data, or for a tool that also helps you take action? Dropship.io charges $59/month for analysis. For a similar price, Copyfy adds store creation and coaching.

Credit system vs unlimited access. Dropship.io works with monthly credits (10,000 to 50,000 depending on the plan). Each product viewed consumes one. Some alternatives like Copyfy (Growth plan) or Minea offer unlimited searches, which is a game changer if you do a lot of volume.

Coverage of advertising platforms. If you are making purchases on TikTok, check that the tool covers this channel. Dropship.io added TikTok recently, but Winning Hunter and Minea have more mature coverage.

Support and support. If you are just starting out, live coaching is worth more than all the databases in the world. Copyfy is the only one to offer weekly sessions with an expert (Growth and Pro plan).

Test before you commit

All of these platforms offer free trials or entry packages. Take the opportunity to compare:

  • Copyfy (5 free days): test the complete journey, from product research to store generation
  • Ecomhunt (free plan): explore curated products and detailed sheets
  • Dropship.io (7 days): if you are still hesitant, compare directly with the alternatives

FAQ - Alternatives to Dropship.io

Is there a free Dropship.io alternative?

No 100% free equivalent with the same features. You can use the Facebook Ad Library and the TikTok Creative Center for free, but these tools are manual and limited. Ecomhunt offers a free plan with restricted access to products. To test without risk, free trials of Copyfy (5 days) or Dropship.io (7 days) are still your best option.

Is Dropship.io reliable for sales data?

Dropship.io uses estimates based on Shopify store activity. Several users reported discrepancies between the numbers shown and their own actual sales data. This is a common problem with tools that estimate revenue without direct access to store dashboards. Always cross-reference data with other sources before you start working on a product.

Can I use Dropship.io and another platform at the same time?

Yes, some e-retailers combine two complementary tools. For example, Copyfy for the complete journey (research + store creation) and Winning Hunter for a focus on ad spend data. But for most users, a single detailed tool is more than enough.

What tool should you choose to start dropshipping?

For someone starting from scratch, Copyfy offers the most structured path: free e-commerce training included, AI store builder (no need to know how to code or design), weekly coaching to unlock situations, and responsive support. The Starter plan at €39/month allows you to start without breaking the bank.

How do I migrate from Dropship.io?

Strictly speaking, there is no data migration. Your favorites and watchlists stay on Dropship.io. Simply create your account on the new platform and start your search again. With Copyfy, you can analyze the stores you followed on Dropship.io and copy them in one click via the Shop Analysis module.

What is Dropship Spy?

Dropship Spy has reinvented itself as an AI-powered product validation tool. In 30 seconds, you get a verdict like ""worth testing"" or ""avoid"", with estimated buying price, recommended resale price, margin after ads and saturation level. Every claim links back to the source it pulled from.

The business model has changed too: no more subscription. You now work with pay-as-you-go credits (1 credit = 1 product searched), starting at $29 for 15 credits, and credits never expire. A first search is free on sign-up, no credit card required.

What is EchoTik?

EchoTik is a TikTok Shop analytics platform developed by Echosell Corporation in Singapore. The tool targets sellers, creators, and brands who want to identify trending products, track the performance of influencers, and analyze live streams on TikTok.

As for prices, it is one of the cheapest tools on the market: a free plan exists for light use, then $9.90/month (Basic), $19.90/month (Pro) and $29.90/month (Enterprise). The Chrome extension allows you to consult the stats directly on TikTok, and the TikTok Shop price calculator is a handy little bonus for estimating your margins.

And above all, there is no tool to take action: once your product is located, you have to create your store, write your product sheets and configure your design yourself. Shop Analysis dissects any Shopify store: estimated sales, theme used, apps installed, best sellers with calculated margins. You can copy an entire store using the built-in AI.

How to avoid the saturation of the products found?

Saturation comes largely from tools that share the same curated products with all their users, as is the case with Ecomhunt. To avoid it: prefer tools with real-time scraping (Niche Scraper), deeper databases (Copyfy, Dropship.io), or cross results from several sources. Also aim for products with recent growth signals rather than established “winners”.

What is the Facebook Ads Library?

Facebook Ads Library (or Meta Ad Library) is the advertising transparency tool launched by Meta in 2019. At its core, it was created to meet the requirements of political transparency. Since then, anyone can access it for free, without a Meta account, to view all active ads on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and the Audience Network.

What Facebook Ads Library does well:

  • Free access without registration to all active ads
  • Search by advertiser or by keyword
  • Filtering by country, platform, and content type
  • History of political ads preserved for 7 years
  • Visualization of creative variants of the same campaign

Where it gets stuck:

  • No performance data (no CTR, no conversions, no ROAS)
  • Impossible to see targeted audiences
  • No engagement metrics (likes, comments, shares)
  • Very limited filters: country, advertiser, category... and that's it
  • No backup function or ad organization
  • No native export or download tools
  • 100% manual trend tracking

Facebook Ads Library is still a good tool for taking a quick look at the ads of a specific competitor. But as soon as you're looking to analyze trends, identify winning products, or build a real advertising intelligence workflow, you're going to need something stronger.

Why look for an alternative to Facebook Ads Library?

What is FastMoss?

FastMoss (formerly FastData) is an analytics platform specialized in the TikTok Shop ecosystem. With over 700,000 claimed users and a database spanning over 50 million products and 250 million creators in 15 countries, it's one of the most complete tools for analyzing business performance on TikTok.

FastMoss highlights:

  • TikTok Shop database among the largest on the market (50M+ products)
  • Coverage of 15 countries with detailed sales data
  • Analysis of creators and influencers with contact data
  • Integrated AI tools (video transcription, script rewriting)
  • Real-time live and video monitoring
  • Recognition by SourceForge as a “Top Performer” in analytics

FastMoss limitations:

  • High dollar rate: from $59/month (Basic plan), up to $199/month (Ultimate)
  • Exclusively focused on TikTok (no Meta, Pinterest, or Google covers)
  • Complex and sometimes overloaded interface for beginners
  • Data sometimes out of date (updates from the previous day on the Pro plan)
  • No creative features (store, visuals, copywriting)
  • Support and interface only in English
  • Reports of unexpected price increases after the first month

FastMoss is still a great choice if your business is based solely on TikTok Shop and you need very advanced analytics data. But if you are looking for multi-platform coverage, integrated creation tools or French-speaking support, other solutions offer a better feature/price ratio.

FAQ - Alternatives to FastMoss

What is the best free alternative to FastMoss?

There is no 100% free alternative equivalent to FastMoss. However, you can use the TikTok Creative Center (free but limited) to explore advertising trends, or the TikTok Ads Library to manually find active ads. EchoTik offers a Basic plan at $9.90/month which is still very accessible. For a complete test, free trials of Copyfy (5 days) or Kalodata (7 days) allow you to explore the functionalities without commitment.

Is FastMoss really the best tool for TikTok Shop?

FastMoss is one of the most detailed in terms of TikTok Shop data volume (50M+ products, 250M+ creators). However, “better” depends on your usage. Kalodata offers fresher data with a refresh every 15 minutes. EchoTik is more accessible in price. And if your business isn't limited to TikTok, Copyfy offers cross-platform coverage with built-in creative tools that FastMoss doesn't.

Why is FastMoss so expensive?

FastMoss's rates ($59 to $199/month) reflect the breadth of its database and the depth of its analytics. However, several users are reporting unexpected price increases after the first few months of subscription. If the budget is a barrier, alternatives like EchoTik ($9.90/month), Shoplus ($29/month) or Copyfy (49€/month with a complete workflow) offer an excellent quality/price ratio.

Can I use multiple tools at the same time?

Yes, some advanced e-retailers combine several tools according to their needs. For example, Copyfy for the complete workflow (products + store + Meta ads) and Kalodata or EchoTik for an in-depth TikTok Shop focus. But for most users, a single thorough tool like Copyfy is more than enough, especially if you're just starting out.

FastMoss or Kalodata: which one to choose?

Both are great TikTok Shop tools, but with different approaches. FastMoss excels in data volume and global coverage (15 countries), while Kalodata offers faster updates and better detection of “blue ocean” opportunities. FastMoss is best suited for agencies and big brands. Kalodata is often preferred by individual sellers. If you want to go beyond TikTok, neither covers Meta or Shopify: in that case, Copyfy is the best option.

What tool to start TikTok e-commerce today?

For a total beginner, Copyfy is the most logical choice thanks to its free e-commerce training included, its AI store generator (no need for technical skills), its weekly coaching and its French-speaking support. If you only want to explore TikTok Shop data without investing a lot, EchoTik at $9.90/month is a good place to start.

What is Peeksta?

Peeksta is a tool for finding winning products created by Kamil Sattar, better known as The Ecom King. The platform combines product research, advertising espionage (Facebook and TikTok), and AI-assisted marketing content creation.

  • No real free trial, just 1 day at $1 to test

  • No store generator: you get stuck at the search stage
  • Advanced features (filters by ad spend, followed by 100 stores) are reserved for the Premium plan at $99.99/month

What is Sell The Trend?

Sell The Trend is a Canadian platform designed for English speaking e-retailers. The heart of the system is NEXUS: an AI engine that sifts through millions of products to identify those who are rising.

Concretely, the tool covers quite a bit of ground. Search for products on AliExpress, Amazon, and CJdropshipping. Facebook ad spy (TikTok only on the Pro plan). Analysis of competing stores. Automated fulfilment. And even a store builder called SellShop. As for integrations, it's broad: Shopify, WooCommerce, eBay, TikTok Shop, Wix, Amazon.

Sell The Trend highlights:

NEXUS AI cross-references 26 data points per product to anticipate trends. Automation goes a long way: 1-click import, automatic fulfillment, dynamic pricing. In-house experts select hand-picked products every day. And the list of integrations (Shopify, WooCommerce, WooCommerce, eBay, eBay, TikTok Shop) is one of the longest on the market.

Sell The Trend limits:

  • Follow-up reports every 2 weeks

Where it gets stuck:

  • No creation tools (no store builder, no ad creation)
  • Ad spy lacks depth compared to dedicated tools

What is Spocket?

Spocket is a supplier marketplace and a fulfillment tool designed for dropshipping. Its promise: connect your Shopify, WooCommerce, or Wix store to a catalog of suppliers mostly based in the United States and Europe, with shorter delivery times than those of AliExpress. You import products in a few clicks, and Spocket handles automated ordering and tracking.

Spocket highlights:

  • US and EU suppliers with fast shipping
  • Catalog of over 100 million products
  • Branded invoice customized to your brand
  • Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, eBay, and Amazon integrations

Limits of Spocket:

  • Price that climbs quickly: $39.99/month on Starter, $59.99/month on Professional, up to $299.99/month
  • Tool focused on sourcing: no Ad Spy to spot the products that are crushing it in ads
  • No AI store builder or competitive store analysis

What is SpySales?

SpySales is a Warsaw-based Shopify sales tracking tool that uses Meta Ads pixel data to estimate the revenue and performance of competing stores. The tool allows you to track daily sales, identify best sellers and consult the historical trends of a store.

What SpySales does well:

  • Shopify sales tracking in real time via the Facebook pixel
  • Simple interface and quick handling
  • AI-assisted product research (“Magic Search”)
  • Identification of top stores and trendy products
  • Sales history to identify seasonalities

Where SpySales shows its limits:

  • Only works with stores that launch Facebook Ads (no organic data)
  • Limited to Shopify, impossible to track WooCommerce or other platforms
  • No TikTok Ads data, an important blind spot today
  • Limited advanced filtering (no sorting by price category or sales bracket)
  • Data updated with a delay, not really “real time” in the strict sense
  • No creation or automation features
  • User feedback about billing and support issues

SpySales is still a good choice if you just want to monitor a few Shopify stores that advertise on Facebook. But if you're looking for a tool that covers your entire workflow, the alternatives below offer much more value.

1. Copyfy: the all-in-one solution to go beyond tracking 🏆

The positioning: Copyfy doesn't just show you what's selling. It is the only French-speaking platform that takes you from product research to the launch of your Shopify store, all in a few minutes.

Why choose Copyfy over SpySales?

A complete workflow, not just tracking

Where SpySales stops at “this store sells X products per day”, Copyfy allows you to take concrete action on this data. You identify a product that works, you analyze the store that sells it, and you generate your own optimized store in 5 minutes using AI. Estimated gain: 40 hours on the creation of a complete store.

Modules that are changing the game:

  • Ad Spy: daily analysis of Meta and TikTok ads (SpySales does not cover TikTok)
  • Product Database: over 100,000 products with verified sales figures
  • Shop Analysis: complete analysis of any Shopify store (sales, traffic, theme, apps, margins)
  • Store AI: Generates an entire store from an AliExpress, Amazon, or Shopify product link

An Ad Spy that covers Meta AND TikTok

SpySales is based solely on the Facebook pixel. If your competitors are making a lot of money on TikTok (and this is increasingly the case), you are missing out on essential data. Copyfy's Ad Spy analyzes both platforms, using “Recent” filters to identify rising trends.

Support and training in French

Chat in French, weekly live coaching with e-commerce experts (Growth plan), and free dropshipping training included in all plans. SpySales offers ticket support in English, which can be a problem if you target French-speaking markets.

For whom?

✅ You want a complete solution that goes from tracking to store creation

✅ You target French-speaking markets (FR, BE, CA)

✅ You are starting out and you need concrete support

✅ You want to cover Meta AND TikTok in your analysis

⚠️ Less suitable if you only need to track 200+ stores (the Pro plan follows 120 stores max)

Pricing

  • Starter: €39/month (5 AI shops/month, 30 searches per month)
  • Growth: 59€/month (unlimited everything + weekly coaching + AI analysis)
  • Pro: 89€/month (120 monitored shops + verified supplier agents)
  • Free 5-day trial without a credit card
  • 40% discount on annual plans

Do you want a complete dropshipping workflow (analysis + creation + automation)?→ Copyfy is the most logical choice. It's the only tool that takes you from research to online store in minutes.

Do you want a more accurate Shopify sales tracker than SpySales?→ Shophunter offers hourly data and a recognized probabilistic algorithm, but at a higher price.

Do you have a limited budget and want to test Ad Spy?→ Peeksta gives you access to Facebook, TikTok and Pinterest for less than $20/month.

Are you starting out and looking for winning products that are ready to sell?→ NicheScraper provides you with complete product sheets with margin, targeting, and ad examples.

Are you an advertising expert and want the largest database?→ Minea remains the reference for pure advertising espionage.

2. Criteria not to be overlooked

Coverage of advertising platforms. SpySales only covers Facebook via the pixel. Today, TikTok represents a growing portion of e-commerce traffic. Verify that your tool covers the platforms on which you do your campaigns.

The features/price ratio. Do you pay for simple tracking, or for an ecosystem that helps you act on the data you collect? A tool like Copyfy at €49/month offers tracking, Ad Spy, product research AND store creation. Compare with SpySales, which only does tracking for $25/month.

Support and language. If you target French-speaking markets, support in French makes a real difference when you have a technical problem or a strategic question. Copyfy and Minea are the only ones on this list to offer native support in French.

Capacity for action. Tracking and analysis is good. But what makes money is your ability to quickly move from insight to action. Choose tools that help you use data, not just consult it.

3. Test before you commit

  1. Start with Copyfy (5 days free) to test the complete workflow
  2. Compare with Peeksta ($1 for 1 day) if budget is your priority

FAQ - Alternatives to SpySales

What is the best free alternative to SpySales?

There is no 100% free equivalent to SpySales. On the other hand, you can combine the Facebook Ad Library (free) and the TikTok Creative Center (free) to get an overview of the ads of your competitors. NicheScraper offers a free account with limited access. And free trials of Copyfy (5 days) or Minea allow you to test the full functionalities without risk.

Is SpySales reliable at estimating sales?

SpySales uses Meta pixel data to estimate sales, making it dependent on the presence of Facebook ads. If a store does not advertise on Facebook, or if it generates most of its traffic via TikTok, Google Ads, or SEO, the data will be incomplete or absent. Estimates are to be taken as indicators, not as exact figures.

Can SpySales and Copyfy be used together?

Technically yes, but for most dropshippers, Copyfy is enough on its own. It includes a Shopify store analysis module that provides access to estimated sales, traffic, best sellers and margins. Plus, you have the Ad Spy, the product database, and the AI store builder, which makes adding SpySales redundant.

What tool to start dropshipping today?

For a total beginner, Copyfy is the most complete choice: free e-commerce training included, AI store builder to launch without technical skills, weekly coaching with experts, support in French, and a starting price of €39/month. SpySales gives raw data but does not assist you in exploiting them.

Why leave SpySales today?

The most common reasons: limited coverage to Facebook (no TikTok), data only on Shopify, updates not always in real time, and lack of creation or automation features. The market has evolved towards more complete solutions that make it possible to move from analysis to action in the same tool.

What alternative to SpySales should you choose?

SpySales has the merit of being simple and straightforward to track Shopify sales via Facebook Ads. But its limitations in terms of coverage (no TikTok, no organic data) and complementary tools (no creation, no automation) make it insufficient for a complete dropshipping workflow today.

🏆 For the majority of dropshippers: Copyfy offers the best features/price ratio with a complete ecosystem from search to online store.

📊 For advanced Shopify tracking: Shophunter provides more accurate hourly data, but at a premium rate.

💰 For small budgets: Peeksta gives access to a multi-platform Ad Spy for less than $20 per month.

🔍 For the search for winning products: NicheScraper provides detailed product sheets with targeting and sample ads.

📱 For media buying experts: Minea remains the reference with its 500M+ advertising base.

What is StoreLeads?

StoreLeads is an e-commerce data platform developed by Lochside Software (United Kingdom), primarily designed for marketing agencies, application developers, and investment funds. The tool makes it possible to discover, segment and enrich data on millions of online stores across multiple platforms (Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, Magento, etc.).

StoreLeads highlights:

  • Massive database with over 40 attributes tracked per store
  • 60 segmentation filters to precisely target an audience
  • Weekly Data Update
  • Native CRM integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Outreach)
  • Cross-platform coverage (Shopify, BigCommerce, Squarespace, Wix, etc.)
  • API available for custom data enrichment

StoreLeads limits:

  • High rates: from $75/month (Premium), $250/month for data export (Pro), up to $950/month (Enterprise)
  • B2B prospecting oriented, not well suited to the dropshipping workflow
  • No Advertising Spying or Looking for Winning Products
  • No store builder or creation tools
  • Complex Interface, Significant Learning Curve for Beginners

What is Winning Hunter?

Winning Hunter is a platform for advertising espionage and finding winning products launched in the United States. The tool is distinguished by its advanced filters to sort ads by ad spend and its “Magic AI” to analyze market saturation.

Winning Hunter highlights:

  • Ad spend filtering to identify ads that are scaling
  • Magic AI Search to find competitors and analyze saturation
  • Sales Tracker with estimated daily revenue
  • Facebook and TikTok coverage (Standard plan)
  • Integrated TikTok watermark removal

Winning Hunter limits:

  • High pricing: 49€/month for Basic (Facebook only), 79€/month for TikTok
  • Key features locked on higher plans
  • No built-in store builder
  • Interface and support mainly in English
  • Very short free trial (3 days only)
  • Sales Tracker accuracy varies from store to store

Winning Hunter is still a good choice if you're only looking for an ad analytics tool with ad spend filters, but other solutions offer a more complete workflow at the same or lower price.

What is BuildYourStore?
